label: Bot Garden Fonts
description: Fredoka, the rounded title and button face of Olive’s Island (the bot-garden template), bundled so an app renders it offline and never asks fonts.googleapis.com. A variable font, latin and latin-extended subsets (French needs the extended œ), loaded by a stylesheet the module injects; use it as font-family: "Fredoka". SIL Open Font License 1.1 — the licence travels with it. No nodes, no code.
